items.title: European Commission proposes €45 billion in Ukraine financing for 2027
items.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen reportedly announced a proposed €45 billion financing programme for Ukraine in 2027, with another €25 billion expected from partners. The proposal requires consideration by EU member states.

items.title: EU financial support for Ukraine reportedly reached $15 billion in November
items.summary: Calculations based on Ukrainian Finance Ministry data put EU financial assistance to Ukraine in November at $15 billion. Total Western financial assistance since February 2022 was estimated at $227.9 billion.
